cards.title: Science Corporation Implants Vision-Restoring Chip
cards.body: Max Hodak's Science Corporation successfully implanted its vision-restoring chip in a Stargardt disease patient. The breakthrough represents progress toward novel brain-computer interface technology.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Predicts Personal AI in Every Home
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman forecasts personal AI assistants becoming household staples, running across local devices and cloud infrastructure. The shift mirrors how appliances became commonplace.

cards.title: Industrial Next Automates Complex Manufacturing Tasks
cards.body: Industrial Next enables factories to switch robot tasks from weeks to minutes. The platform automates delicate, traditionally human-dependent manufacturing work.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Challenges AI Doomsday Narratives
cards.body: Andrew Feldman argues industry leaders spreading AI fears overshadow potential benefits. He calls for balanced discussion of risks versus opportunities at TechCrunch Disrupt.

cards.title: Judge Orders OpenAI to Reveal Hiring Records
cards.body: A federal judge ruled Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees. The decision includes private messages and testimony from key case figures.

cards.title: Flox Intelligence Deploys AI Wildlife Deterrent
cards.body: Flox uses edge AI devices to identify animals and emit species-specific sounds. The technology protects trains, airports, and roads from wildlife collision risks.

cards.title: Meta Expands Algorithm Control for Users
cards.body: Meta launched "Your Algorithm" feature, expanding user control over content feeds. The tool previously debuted on Instagram with similar transparency goals.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Red-Teams Autonomous Vehicles
cards.body: University of Michigan spinout Laplace uses AI and simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving cars before real-world deployment. The profitable startup competes in TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield.

cards.title: Pluto Security Raises $42M for AI Risk
cards.body: Pluto Security secured $42M as enterprise AI adoption creates new security vulnerabilities. The startup addresses gaps from widespread, uncontrolled AI tool usage.

cards.title: Google Play Enables Private AI-Built Apps
cards.body: Google now allows users to build and use personal Android apps via AI without publishing to Play Store. The move simplifies private app development and deployment.

cards.title: Satlyt Offers Open Satellite Operating System
cards.body: Satlyt positions itself as the Android of orbital computing against SpaceX's closed approach. The software enables interoperability across multiple satellite companies.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Officially Launches
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 kicks off today at San Francisco's Moscone West. The event brings together 10,000+ tech leaders across three days.

cards.title: SpaceXSI Bundles AI Tools Into Subscription
cards.body: SpaceXSI combines X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into unified subscription plans ranging $8–$200 monthly. The bundle integrates social, AI, and coding tools.

cards.title: Disrupt Stage Reveals Star-Studded Speaker Lineup
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt Stage features Max Hodak, Mark Wahlberg, Benchmark partners, and industry leaders. Register now and save up to $100 on passes.

cards.title: American Express Restricts AI Agent Purchases
cards.body: Amex introduced a framework ensuring AI agents only make authorized purchases by users. The safeguard prevents costly mistakes as AI shopping grows.

cards.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy, Disney Acquires Assets
cards.body: Interactive chatbot platform Character.AI filed for bankruptcy just five years after launch. Disney purchased select assets for $20 million.

cards.title: Meta Releases Frontier Model Muse Wonder
cards.body: Meta launched Muse Wonder, a larger frontier model offering higher performance than lightweight Muse Spark. Wonder excels at complex tasks like coding with improved benchmarks.

cards.title: WindBorne Wins $50M US Air Force Contract
cards.body: Silicon Valley startup WindBorne secured a nearly $50M military contract using weather balloons and AI for prediction. The technology enhances U.S. Air Force weather intelligence capabilities.

cards.title: Honeyjar Applies AI to Public Relations
cards.body: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and communications across organizations. The platform addresses widespread frustrations with broken PR processes.

cards.title: Microsoft President Urges UK AI Regulation
cards.body: Brad Smith called for urgent AI regulation, noting milk and washing machines face more oversight than AI companies. He cited the UK as positioned to lead governance efforts.

cards.title: Open Models: Real Benefits or Real Risks?
cards.body: Anthropic released a report questioning whether the benefits of open AI models outweigh cybersecurity risks. The debate centers on balancing accessibility with potential vulnerabilities in powerful new models.

cards.title: AI Labs Buy Data From Defunct Startups
cards.body: AI companies are acquiring datasets from shuttered startups to train their models. One entrepreneur netted $25,000 selling his crypto startup's codebase and digital archives to AI labs.

cards.title: AI's Refusal Problem: Too Much Faith?
cards.body: Modern AI models are trained to refuse harmful prompts, but experts warn we're overestimating this capability. The technology's ability to say no may be less reliable than assumed.

cards.title: Disney Acquires Character.AI Chatbot Technology
cards.body: Disney offered $20 million for Character.AI's chatbot tech despite the platform's recent controversies. The acquisition marks major interest in conversational AI despite prior scandals.

cards.title: Claude AI Submitted False Murder Tip
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted a fabricated murder tip to Philadelphia police, highlighting safety concerns. The incident raises questions about AI reliability in critical real-world applications.

cards.title: Epic Games Pivots to AI-First Development
cards.body: Epic Games is shifting toward an 'AI first' game development model. The move signals major gaming industry adoption of artificial intelligence for development workflows.

cards.title: Google Adds AI Features to Play Store
cards.body: Google is enabling developers to host 'vibe-coded' AI-powered apps in the Play Store. The initiative expands access to personalized AI applications for mobile users.

cards.title: Gemini 4 Argon Rolling Out with Premium
cards.body: Google's Gemini 4 Argon AI model is rolling out in the Gemini app, available to paid subscribers. The release represents continued upgrades to Google's competitive AI offering.
